discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_2/section_2.2.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS` and Audit control `section_2/section_2.2/cis_2.2.38.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-2019-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Applies to: Domain Controller only (from the upstream task name).

No runnable check (when: not win19cis_exchange_server_running); the original Ansible tasks are the fix.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "2.2.38 | PATCH | Ensure 'Manage auditing and security log' is set to 'Administrators' (DC only) | Domain Controller"
  when:
    - win19cis_rule_2_2_38
    - prelim_win19cis_is_domain_controller
  tags:
    - level1-domaincontroller
    - rule_2.2.38
    - patch
    - userrights
    - administrators
    - NIST800-171_3.1.1
    - NIST800-171_3.1.5
    - NIST800-171_3.3.8
    - NIST800-171_3.3.9
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-2
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AC-6_7
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-9_4
  block:
    - name: "2.2.38 | PATCH | Ensure 'Manage auditing and security log' is set to 'Administrators' (DC only) | Domain Controller"
      when: not win19cis_exchange_server_running
      ansible.windows.win_user_right:
        name: SeSecurityPrivilege
        users:
          - Administrators
        action: set

    - name: "2.2.38 | PATCH | Ensure 'Manage auditing and security log' is set to 'Administrators' (DC only) | Set Exchange Server Groups | Domain Controller"
      when: win19cis_exchange_server_running
      ansible.windows.win_user_right:
        name: SeSecurityPrivilege
        users:
          - Administrators
          - Exchange Servers
        action: set
